clue.text: Difficult to understand Jack's real point that had been accepted

parts.note: a jack is a sailor, abbreviated AB (able seaman), plus the possessive S

indicators.note: something accepted is taken in, so the point goes inside the word for real

parts.note: real means true
S is a compass point, south

explanation.surface: Someone struggles to follow a sailor's genuine argument that others had already accepted.
explanation.definitionFit: Abstruse writing is obscure and hard to grasp, a direct synonym for difficult to understand.

clue.text: Aid musician starting late

indicators.note: a player starting late misses the opening, so the first letter is dropped

parts.note: a bass player, one kind of musician

explanation.surface: A band member who turns up late needs some help.
explanation.definitionFit: To assist is to give aid, a straightforward verb synonym.

clue.text: Look at Ireland, say, from these mountains

indicators.note: say signals that the phrase is spoken, giving the sound of another word

parts.note: to look at something is to see it; Eire is the Irish-language name for Ireland

explanation.surface: From these peaks you could gaze across to Ireland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from these' is padding linking the spoken phrase to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A sierra is a jagged mountain range, as in Spain's Sierra Nevada.

clue.text: Hold back engineers and reporters

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, the British Army corps
the press is the body of journalists

explanation.surface: Soldiers and journalists are kept at bay.
explanation.definitionFit: To repress feelings is to restrain or hold them back.

clue.text: Said type later much in demand

indicators.note: said signals that the word for type is spoken, sounding like another word

parts.note: a type is a sort or kind
later means after

explanation.surface: A printing font described as becoming popular later on.
explanation.definitionFit: Something sought after is eagerly wanted, so it is much in demand.

clue.text: Confusion when yours truly has second drink

parts.note: yours truly is the speaker, me
to sup is to drink

explanation.surface: Things get muddled when the speaker has a second glass.
explanation.definitionFit: A mess-up is a muddle or blunder, a noun meaning confusion.

clue.text: Blissful place, city individual getting in the money

parts.note: Ely is a cathedral city in Cambridgeshire

indicators.note: the individual is getting into the money, so the letter goes inside

parts.note: a sum is an amount of money
I, the Roman numeral one, stands for an individual

explanation.surface: A city dweller striking it rich finds paradise.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Elysium was the paradise of the blessed dead, hence any place of bliss.

clue.text: Start journey determined to go over river

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece goes over, above, the other

parts.note: set, as in set on something, means determined
the Forth is a Scottish river

explanation.surface: A resolute traveller sets out to cross a river.
explanation.definitionFit: To set forth is to set off, a phrasal verb meaning begin a journey.

clue.text: Super ale brewed for enjoyment

indicators.note: brewing mixes ingredients, so these letters are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: A top-class beer brewed simply for the pleasure of drinking it.
explanation.definitionFit: Pleasure is delight or enjoyment, a plain synonym.

clue.text: That female's race record included on grazing land

indicators.note: the record is included within the other pieces

parts.note: that female is she, the 's being is
a run is a race
an EP is an extended-play record

explanation.surface: A woman's racing record lists events held on farmland.
explanation.definitionFit: A sheep run is a tract of pasture where sheep graze.

clue.text: Crumbs! Right to take the Parisian shrub

parts.note: crumbs and my are both mild exclamations of surprise
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Someone exclaims as the Frenchman is right to take the plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Myrtle is an evergreen shrub with fragrant white flowers.

clue.text: Shriek when debris is found in front of church

indicators.note: the debris is placed in front of the church

parts.note: scree is loose rocky debris on a slope

explanation.surface: Someone screams on discovering rubble before the church door.
explanation.definitionFit: A screech is a harsh piercing cry, a noun synonym for shriek.

clue.text: Collapse round you and me is crippling

parts.note: ruin is downfall or collapse
O is round in shape
you and me together are us

explanation.surface: A breakdown affecting both of us proves disabling.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruinous costs are disastrous or crippling, an adjective synonym.

clue.text: Harvest part to divide again

parts.note: to reap is to harvest
a portion is a part or share

explanation.surface: A farmer splits the harvest into shares a second time.
explanation.definitionFit: To reapportion is to share out or allocate afresh, so divide again.

clue.text: Attempt at mother's Latin hymn

parts.note: a stab is a try or attempt
taken as written
mater is Latin for mother, the 's being is

explanation.surface: A child tries out a hymn in Latin with their mother.
explanation.definitionFit: The Stabat Mater is a medieval Latin hymn on Mary's sorrows at the Cross.

clue.text: Sue moved around completely to her advantage

parts.note: fully means completely

explanation.surface: Sue relocates and does very well out of it.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting usefully means acting to good effect, benefiting oneself or another.

clue.text: Fish and fruit expert

parts.note: a lemon is a citrus fruit
a dab, as in dab hand, is an expert

explanation.surface: Fish dish served with fruit by a skilled cook.
explanation.definitionFit: The lemon dab is a flatfish, also called lemon sole.

clue.text: Hackneyed poetry rewritten about horse? On the contrary

indicators.note: about would put the rearranged poetry around the horse
says the reverse holds, so the horse goes about the rearranged poetry

parts.note: a steed is a horse

indicators.note: rewritten words have their letters put in a fresh order

explanation.surface: Tired verse revised to describe a horse, or the other way round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' alone would wrap the rewritten poetry round the horse; 'On the contrary' flips it, so the horse wraps the anagram instead.
explanation.definitionFit: Stereotyped ideas are fixed and unoriginal, hence hackneyed.

clue.text: Pin removed in dangerous experiment — the result is most violent

indicators.note: removed tells us the letters of Pin are taken away from the pool
dangerous suggests letters exploding into a new order

explanation.surface: A grenade pin is pulled in a risky test, with explosive results.
explanation.walkthrough: EXPERIMENT less P, I, N leaves EXERMET, rearranged by 'dangerous'.
explanation.definitionFit: Extreme is a superlative sense, the utmost or most severe degree.

clue.text: Duke can put something out of action

parts.note: can means is able

explanation.surface: A duke is capable of wrecking a machine.
explanation.definitionFit: To disable is to make inoperative, putting a thing out of action.

clue.text: Admiral, big timer on front of ship

parts.note: Big Ben, the great bell of the clock at Westminster, is a big timer
the bow is the front of a ship

explanation.surface: An admiral stands with a large clock at the ship's prow.
explanation.definitionFit: John Benbow was a celebrated English admiral of the late 1600s.

clue.text: Absolutely tunelessly

definitions.meaning: singing flat means below pitch, tunelessly

explanation.definitionFit: Flatly means absolutely, as in refused flatly, and also off-key in music.

clue.text: Cork's undecided voter?

definitions.meaning: cork floats, so a piece of it is something that bobs on water
a floating voter has no fixed party loyalty

explanation.definitionFit: A float on a line can be cork, and a floating voter is uncommitted.

clue.text: Philosopher from Rugby's to be a retailer

parts.note: RU is Rugby Union, plus the possessive S
a retailer's job is to sell

explanation.surface: A rugby player gives up to become a shopkeeper and thinker.
explanation.definitionFit: Bertrand Russell was a famous British philosopher and logician.

clue.text: Book shelf has little resistance

parts.note: a ledge is a narrow shelf
R is the symbol for electrical resistance, little meaning abbreviated

explanation.surface: A bookshelf offers almost no resistance.
explanation.definitionFit: A ledger is an account book recording transactions.

clue.text: Gradually get pieces lined up

definitions.meaning: slowly, a little at a time
pieces in a row, one bit beside another

explanation.definitionFit: Bit by bit means step by step, and literally pictures small pieces in a line.

clue.text: Australian talk

parts.note: a slang word from Down Under for chatter or jabber

explanation.definitionFit: Yabber is Australian slang for talk or chatter, from an Aboriginal word.

clue.text: Proceeding taking the low road

definitions.meaning: going beneath, along the lower way

explanation.definitionFit: Under way means in progress, and literally suggests a route below.
